reports.title: 'I'm Here as a Dad': El-Sayed Demands Justice For Epstein Survivors, Blasts White House 'Cover-up'
reports.description:
Abdul El-Sayed delivered an emotional address at an event honouring survivors of Jeffrey Epstein's abuse, where 1,400 candles symbolised girls and young women whose lives were affected.
